about: The producer public key that signs Carbon's sealed exams on one network, pinned in the release a validator installs (Validator, E4 condition 1). A validator accepts exam packages signed by this key only, and only on this network: an install on any other network refuses it (exam_producer_wrong_network), so a mainnet install never trusts the testnet key. An exam-source file never supplies a key. Set by the decision named here; changed only by a reviewed commit.
